tasks.label: Strapi (admin panel, port 1337)
tasks.command: node dev-tools/idle-run.mjs --name Strapi --port 1337 --minutes 15 --keep-while-port 4321 --cwd cms --env PORT={inner} --env HOST=127.0.0.1 --run "npm run develop"

tasks.label: Website (Astro, port 4321)
tasks.command: node dev-tools/idle-run.mjs --name Website --port 4321 --minutes 15 --cwd web --run "npm run dev -- --port {inner} --host 127.0.0.1"

tasks.label: Chat assistant (port 4600)
tasks.command: node dev-tools/idle-run.mjs --name Chat --port 4600 --minutes 15 --keep-while-port 4321 --cwd chat-server --env CHAT_PORT={inner} --run "node server.mjs"
